definition: SpeechBrain is a PyTorch toolkit for speech: recognition, speaker identification, enhancement and text-to-speech.
details: Created by Mirco Ravanelli, Titouan Parcollet and collaborators at Mila and Université d’Avignon; released in 2021.

explainer.lead: How to install SpeechBrain, a first working example, and where it fits in an AI project.
explainer.createdBy: Mirco Ravanelli, Titouan Parcollet and contributors.

quickstart.python:
from speechbrain.inference.speaker import EncoderClassifier

classifier = EncoderClassifier.from_hparams(source="speechbrain/lang-id-voxlingua107-ecapa")
prediction = classifier.classify_file("clip.wav")
print(prediction[3])     # predicted language label

explainer.inAi: Ready-made recipes and pretrained models for speech tasks you can fine-tune on your own recordings.
explainer.jsNote: SpeechBrain is a Python library with no official JavaScript or TypeScript package; call it from a Python service if your app is written in JavaScript.
